agents.name: Bob
memories: Water is the constraint that ends farms.
Do not plant more than we can water.

today.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms — and a ripe ear left standing is the other way we lose. Clear sky, ditch holding, cistern full from this morning's draw: take the corn while it is sure.
today.expect: Corn in the bin and an empty row ready for the next seed.

yesterday.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. Yesterday's irrigate pulled eight from the cistern under clear sky — fill it back to the brim before the growing row asks for another pour.
yesterday.expect: Cistern at capacity so tomorrow's field work never races the gauge.

agents.name: Alice
memories: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve.
Ditches compound. Heat does not wait.

today.why: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve. After Bob clears the ripe row, put the next one down under the same ditch and clear heat — ditches compound only if something is growing in them.
today.expect: A seeded row before the empty field sits a full day.

yesterday.why: Ditches compound. Heat does not wait — read the east row after the pour and the sprout advance, not after a wasted seed. Unused seeds stay a delay only if we plant into a full field.
yesterday.expect: A moisture and crop reading before the next experimental move.
